notes.title: Happy Holidays and have a Happy New Year 2021!
notes.content:
Hey,

2020 is almost over and Holidays and the Year 2021 are right around the corner.

I wish you to have some nice Holidays and a Happy New Year 2021!

The Year 2021 should be very exciting for I Can Gun, too. Lots of progress has been made and I'm also very happy to announce that the much requested online multiplayer mode will be included at release. More announcements and details are coming in the not too far away future.

Make sure to wishlist the game to stay in touch! Thank you!

Take care :)

notes.title: Tiny progress update
notes.content:
Hey,

Progress on the game is being made in all areas on a daily basis and I should be able to show some of the new features in 2020 :)

The next year is gonna be very exciting for so many reasons and I will also have some really exciting news sometime next year :)

I hope you all have a wonderful Christmas time and a Happy New Year!

Stay tuned and take care :)

notes.title: Coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Nice to have you here. This game is still in development and will become available soon.

Meanwhile you might want to give the [b]free demo[/b] on itch.io a try: https://patrickkoenig.itch.io/i-can-gun

Stay tuned and make use of your wishlist if this is your type of game.

[b]March 31, 2019:[/b]
The game is still under heavy development but as usual everything takes longer than anticipated. Hopefully I will be able to compensate for the wait with an even better experience once it finally becomes available. I will post more updates as potential release is coming closer.
